title: Bimanual 3D Hand Motion and Articulation Forecasting in Everyday Images
abstract: arXiv:2510.06145v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We tackle the problem of forecasting bimanual 3D hand motion and articulation from a single image in everyday settings. To address the lack of 3D hand annotations in diverse settings, we design an annotation pipeline consisting of a diffusion model to lift 2D hand keypoint sequences to 4D hand motion. For the forecasting model, we adopt a diffusion loss to account for the multimodality in hand motion distribution. Extensive experiments on 6 datasets show the benefits of training with our imputed labels (14% improvement) and the effectiveness of our lifting (45% better) & forecasting (16.4% gain) models, over the best baselines, especially in zero-shot generalization to everyday images.

translated_title: 日常图像中的双手3D手部运动与关节姿态预测
translated_abstract: 我们研究从日常场景中的单张图像预测双手3D手部运动与关节姿态的问题。为了解决多样化场景中缺乏3D手部标注的问题，我们设计了一个标注流水线，其中包含一个扩散模型，用于将2D手部关键点序列提升为4D手部运动。对于预测模型，我们采用扩散损失来刻画手部运动分布中的多模态特性。在6个数据集上的大量实验表明，使用我们补全的标签进行训练可带来14%的性能提升，我们的提升模型（提升45%）与预测模型（提升16.4%）相对于最佳基线方法均表现出显著优势，尤其是在对日常图像的零样本泛化能力方面。
tldr: 该论文提出从单张日常图像预测双手3D运动与关节姿态的方法，通过扩散模型将2D关键点序列提升为4D手部运动标注，并采用扩散损失建模运动的多模态性，在多个数据集上显著超越现有基线并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes forecasting bimanual 3D hand motion and articulation from a single everyday image by using a diffusion model to lift 2D keypoint sequences into 4D hand motion annotations and a diffusion loss to model multimodal hand motion, achieving substantial improvements over baselines with strong zero-shot generalization.
